expect.why: @corpus and @working name no revision, so there is nothing to compare and freshness says nothing; this is why every seed written before it stays green, and a later reader who changes UNPINNED finds out here what it costs

history: apply commits/01, commits/02, … as successive commits in a fresh repository; expectations name the commit they apply to. `@commitNN` in an entry is substituted with the real short object id of that commit before it is made, because a seed cannot know an id the runner has not created yet
